name: manual_d06ab8
claim: Read an opt-in test before telling the operator what running it costs. An opt-in flag can guard a side effect other than spend: the real-Cline smoke test uses a fake upstream and a fake key and is opt-in because it starts a shared hub daemon.

decisions.notes: The agent told the operator this test made paid provider requests without checking; it does not. A paid check needs its own bounded run and approval.

rationale: The agent told the operator this test made paid provider requests without checking; it does not. A paid check needs its own bounded run and approval.
